title: Banhi Vol. 1 (বাঁহী - ১ম ভাগ)
author: Lakshminath Bezbaroa (Comp. Basanta Kumar Goswami)
description: The commemorative centennial edition of the revolutionary literary journal 'Banhi' founded in 1909 by Lakshminath Bezbaroa. The journal was the premier vehicle for modern scholarly rediscovery of Tai-Ahom Buranjis, folklore documentation in Upper Assam, and historical philology.
source: Guwahati: Asam Sahitya Sabha & Bani Prakash, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451260
